description: This file defines a PHP script that interacts with the TestLink API to add a test case to a test plan. It prepares request parameters, uses an external client class to communicate with the server, and relies on external utility files.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class for making XML-RPC requests, instantiated to communicate with the test management server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: A function that executes the API call to add a test case to a test plan using the provided client and parameters.
